answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 38376 Country: India Title: If a person farted after the first salam of the salah, is his salah valid or he has to repeat the salah after doing wudhu Question: If a person farted after the first salam of the salah, is his salah valid or he has to repeat the salah after doing wudhu? Please give explanation. Answer ID: 38376 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 869/703/B=1433) Salah is complete on the first mim (ميم) of Assalamu Alaikum. Hence salah was complete on passing wind after first salam. There is no need to re-offer that salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
